name: Bima
description: BIMA is a DeFi ecosystem designed to provide both professional and retail investors with access to high-quality yield strategies globally, all while retaining their Bitcoin holdings. The platform utilizes a stablecoin called USBD, which is over-collateralized by Bitcoin derivatives, allowing investors to stake their BTC and earn liquid-staking derivatives (LSTs). BIMA offers various vaults with different risk-reward profiles, enabling returns ranging from 15-20% APY for low-volatility strategies to 30-60% APY for higher-volatility options. Additionally, BIMA emphasizes security and scalability, with features like decentralized governance, permissioned institutional borrowing, and rigorous security audits to protect users'assets.
